Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Legal here asked for a focused call to walk the MSA redlines and confirm the onboarding checklist that will feed our procurement review. Narrow ask: can we do a 30–40 minute session next week that includes your legal lead and our procurement rep?

Current constraints: our procurement lead (Oliver) is only available mornings EST. Proposed windows: 2028-07-24 09:00–11:00 EDT or 2028-07-25 10:00–12:00 EDT.

I've attached the latest redline we've been working from (helixmed_msa_redline_v3.pdf) and a short procurement Qs doc.

Alyssa — thanks for the context and the files. Confirmed receipt of helixmed_msa_redline_v3.pdf.

We can do 2028-07-25 at 10:00 EDT (that maps to 07:00 PDT for us) — that slot works for me and for Ben. I asked Marissa to loop in Kimberly from Legal; she can cover contract-level clarifications and edge cases.

Proposed attendees from Redwood: Jonas Weber (Sales, host), Marissa Cole (Onboarding/CS), Kimberly Park (Legal), Ben Carter (Implementation). Can you confirm Oliver will be on the call?

If confirmed, I'll send a calendar invite and a short run-of-show: 1) 10–15m redline triage (top 5 items), 2) 10m procurement checklist walk, 3) 5–10m next steps + DocuSign timeline.

On behalf of Legal: Kimberly, please see the redline and flag anything that needs pre-reading. I'll pull together a 1‑page triage doc summarizing the top risk/ask areas so we stay under 40 minutes.

Kimberly — would you prefer we get the 1‑page over to HelixMed ahead of the call, or keep it internal and only surface the decisions during the meeting? My lean is to share the summary 24 hours in advance to speed the conversation.

Attachments: onboard_checklist.xlsx (Excel) — draft checklist we'll go through.

—Marissa
